# Vlamaz — Vladyslav Mazurkevych (Full Background)

> Extended reference for LLMs and crawlers. Canonical source: https://vlamaz.com/background

## Biography

My full name is Vladyslav Mazurkevych. I was born in Ukraine and graduated in
Computer Engineering from the Universitat Politècnica de València, with a
specialization in artificial intelligence. The area where I am most trained
and experienced is Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Data Analysis, but
this does not diminish my interest in other areas of AI.

During my time at university, I enjoyed working on personal projects, which
led me to participate in various student groups as a web developer, where I
learned several technologies. For two years I was part of the Google
Developer Student Clubs (GDSC) as a core team member and later as Lead,
delivering talks on generative AI and organizing events with colleagues.
Through GDSC peers I became interested in Blockchain and had my first
startup attempt based on that technology.

Subsequently, I took part in an acceleration and incubation program at
Lanzadera, where I acquired business skills including team management,
business strategy, and problem-solving.

Through these ventures I forged a hybrid profile: a full-stack computer
scientist specialized in Machine Learning, with skills in business,
management, marketing, and sales.

Key lessons learned along the way:
- When you need a team for your startup, hire the best you can afford.
  Otherwise, keep going on your own until you can.
- Giving too much freedom to a team costs you dearly — be humane, but not
  overly friendly.
- Nothing is free in this world, especially in business.

## Career timeline

**Google DSC UPV — Core Team / Lead**
Google Developer Student Clubs (GDSC) is a university club program created
by Google Developers and driven by students, running projects, workshops,
and talks about Google technologies. Gave an "Introduction to Machine
Learning" talk and a "Transfer Learning with Keras" workshop to ~50
attendees each; led a team of 5 organizing a talk series with CEOs/CTOs from
Telefónica, Google, IBM, Uniswap, Mercadona, and others.

**Jr. Data Scientist — Datamaran**
Datamaran is an AI platform that helps business leaders navigate the
complex ESG landscape by turning large volumes of information into
actionable insights. Improved an AI model via text preprocessing and
feature engineering; researched new TOC extraction techniques; helped with
test coverage for a company project.

**Founder — Grifenix**
Grifenix started as a no-code smart contract builder on Ethereum, then
pivoted to a blockchain-based interlinked loyalty network platform aimed at
improving local commerce. Developed personalized, user-owned ERC-721 smart
contracts (mainly for goods traceability) on Ethereum (Polygon and Gnosis)
with Solidity; managed a team of 2 under Agile using ClickUp; co-developed
backend and frontend from scratch with Django REST, VueJS, and AWS.

**Lanzadera acceleration program**
Lanzadera is a startup accelerator and incubator driven by its resident
startups, mentors, project directors, partners, and large corporations,
fully privately funded and promoted by Juan Roig (President of Mercadona).
Trained in Mercadona's "Total Quality Model", company management, and how
to build a solid startup; networked with people across many industries.

**Founder — Essenfy**
Essenfy, accelerated at Lanzadera, was an app/platform to reduce food waste
in medium-sized businesses, prioritizing the health and experience of
vulnerable consumers. It ended due to lack of cash. Developed backend and
frontend from scratch with Django REST, Next.js, and AWS; researched a
custom food recipe generator with PyTorch (Transformer model); managed a
team of 2 under Agile-Lean with ClickUp; handled cold sales and marketing.

**Freelance Developer**
Worked as a freelance backend engineer across projects ranging from
ML-oriented startups to small businesses. Developed a RAG-based system for
Ukrainian legal texts achieving ~92% answer accuracy on evaluated official
legal articles, using Litestar, LanceDB, Neo4j, and OpenAI. Built an AI
pipeline with GPT-3.5 and Whisper to process audio calls and extract
structured knowledge from conversations. Implemented full-stack features
for multiple web applications using Next.js and TypeScript.

**Backend Engineer — Plug And Play**
Plug and Play is a global innovation platform connecting startups,
corporations, investors, universities, and governments to accelerate
technological innovation. Built an internal LLM-powered, scraping-based
tool to gather up-to-date startup information, reducing the team's
form-filling and prospecting time. Extended and refactored Django data
models for new data science workflows, including database migrations.
Implemented asynchronous integrations with the Salesforce, Crunchbase, and
Eventbrite APIs, improving processing speed 4x with HTTPX,
simple-salesforce, Python coroutines, and Redis-backed Celery task queues —
supporting a critical workflow for the company's Silicon Valley Summit.
Added unit test coverage and new features to the internal Django REST
Framework API; integrated and maintained SendGrid email workflows;
implemented Celery Beat scheduled jobs; managed backend Docker image
dependency updates and security patches.
